components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. It is normalized before being stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of whitespace
            collapsed to a single space, the value is upper-cased and common abbreviations are
            expanded as whole tokens (ST -> STREET, RD -> ROAD, AVE -> AVENUE). So
            '  12  main  st ' is stored and returned as '12 MAIN STREET'. An address that is
            blank after normalization is rejected with 400. Household duplicate detection and
            the shared household id both compare addresses in this normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The pet owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region per the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), where the region is derived from
            the city (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD). A postcode out of
            range for the city's region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized into E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces,
            dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'. The pattern
            tolerates an optional leading '+' plus digits and separators (spaces, brackets,
            dashes); numbers that cannot form valid E.164 are rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it must be a
            syntactically valid email address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the
            same last name and address (compared case-insensitively, with runs of whitespace
            collapsed). When omitted or false, such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case
                hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name. There is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where customerCode is the owner's '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code and YY
                is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with runs of
                whitespace collapsed). Owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true
                for an address already used by a same-last-name owner receive the same
                value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership level from 1 to 3, computed on creation: starting
                at 1, plus 1 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The pet owner's locality: the REGION segment of the '<REGION>-<HASH8>'
                customer code, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the city-to-region table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD,
                else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (by registration
                date), signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Evaluated against the
                current daily total each time the owner is read.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty' (the normalized E.164
                telephone, then the lower-cased email or an empty string, then the household id or
                an empty string, joined by '|'). This single key is the sole criterion for duplicate
                detection: a create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the new owner's whole
                identity key equals an existing owner's. Because the telephone is part of the key,
                two members of the same household (same householdId) with different telephones have
                distinct identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. It is normalized before being stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of whitespace
            collapsed to a single space, the value is upper-cased and common abbreviations are
            expanded as whole tokens (ST -> STREET, RD -> ROAD, AVE -> AVENUE). So
            '  12  main  st ' is stored and returned as '12 MAIN STREET'. An address that is
            blank after normalization is rejected with 400. Household duplicate detection and
            the shared household id both compare addresses in this normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The pet owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region per the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), where the region is derived from
            the city (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD). A postcode out of
            range for the city's region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized into E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces,
            dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'. The pattern
            tolerates an optional leading '+' plus digits and separators (spaces, brackets,
            dashes); numbers that cannot form valid E.164 are rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it must be a
            syntactically valid email address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it
            is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand', computed as the owner's age in whole years
            at the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the
            same last name and address (compared case-insensitively, with runs of whitespace
            collapsed). When omitted or false, such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case
                hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name. There is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where customerCode is the owner's '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code and YY
                is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with runs of
                whitespace collapsed). Owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true
                for an address already used by a same-last-name owner receive the same
                value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership level from 1 to 3, computed on creation: starting
                at 1, plus 1 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The pet owner's locality: the REGION segment of the '<REGION>-<HASH8>'
                customer code, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the city-to-region table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD,
                else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (by registration
                date), signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Evaluated against the
                current daily total each time the owner is read.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty' (the normalized E.164
                telephone, then the lower-cased email or an empty string, then the household id or
                an empty string, joined by '|'). This single key is the sole criterion for duplicate
                detection: a create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the new owner's whole
                identity key equals an existing owner's. Because the telephone is part of the key,
                two members of the same household (same householdId) with different telephones have
                distinct identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. It is normalized before being stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of whitespace
            collapsed to a single space, the value is upper-cased and common abbreviations are
            expanded as whole tokens (ST -> STREET, RD -> ROAD, AVE -> AVENUE). So
            '  12  main  st ' is stored and returned as '12 MAIN STREET'. An address that is
            blank after normalization is rejected with 400. Household duplicate detection and
            the shared household id both compare addresses in this normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The pet owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When

## Summary

I implemented the `birthDate` → `ageBand` derivation on the `POST /api/owners` / `GET /api/owners/{id}` endpoint.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** (drives DTO generation):
   - Added optional `birthDate` (ISO `date`) to `OwnerFields` — the request-settable fields.
   - Added read-only `ageBand` (string) to the `Owner` response schema, documented as `MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`, absent when no birth date is supplied.

It computes `Period.between(birthDate, registrationDate).getYears()` and returns `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), or `SENIOR` (≥65); returns `null` (field absent) when `birthDate` or `registrationDate` is missing. `birthDate` itself maps through `toOwner`/`toOwnerDto` automatically by name.

4. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table.

The age band is computed against `registrationDate` as specified. For the acceptance test (`birthDate=1990-01-01`, registrationDate defaulting to today), age 36 → `ADULT`, which the test asserts.

Note: the code follows the project's existing pattern for derived read-only fields (`contactPreference`, `locality`), keeping `ageBand` a plain string rather than a generated enum to stay consistent and avoid referencing a nested generated type in the MapStruct interface.
